name: EDGEbuilder
author: Edgemodders
description: A world builder: browse the game's assets, drop them into the live world, move, turn and scale them with a gizmo from a camera of its own, bake them into the world. Also the assets of installed mods and the open REDcode project, and the game's people (NPCs) standing where they are put; B3: several objects at once, groups, copies, undo; named scenes in the Library, the REDcode project or this PC, other scenes shown beside the open one, and a service other packages and assistants call for scenes and their objects.
